problem_statement: Create a browser-based dashboard that connects to SQL database REST APIs and transforms raw query results into visual reports, targeting business users and analysts who need self-service access to database data without writing SQL.
implementation_plan: 1. Complete the core React component implementation with four analysis modes
2. Implement REST API integration with bearer token authentication
3. Add data transformation utilities for query results
5. Implement real-time data updates with configurable intervals
6. Add sample datasets for users and products
7. Set up test infrastructure with Jest and React Testing Library
acceptance_criteria: 1. Dashboard connects to SQL database REST APIs with bearer token auth
2. Four distinct analysis modes (chart, table, stats, realtime) are functional
3. Results render as charts, statistics, and filterable tables
4. Real-time updates work with configurable intervals
6. Component works as a standalone with zero backend/build requirements
7. All tests pass and provide good coverage
